verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI queries captured tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL and can write results to a destination path. It also exports data in a variety of formats, which covers querying and exporting collected robot data for offline analysis. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a programmatic data-query/export SDK or API (the evidence centers on the CLI), details of the supported export formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query and export collected robot data through an API or SQL for offline analysis

citations.quote: viam data query tabular sql --org-id=<org-id> --sql=<query> [--destination=<output path>]
you can export data in a variety of formats, query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL
